text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
It's overrrr! Team Tracen Academy advances 
to the finals!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the day of the "National Team Seven 
Bridge Championship". Cheers for Tracen 
Academy echoed throughout the heat-filled 
venue!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's been a long road, but the finals are 
finally up next. How is everyone feeling?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My grasp on the basics was shaky... I 
apologize for causing trouble.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I will surely make up for it as well. Now 
that things have come to this, I am 
prepared to go down fighting.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now, now. Win or lose, the next match is 
our last. Heh, let's just enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Up to this point, Team Tracen Academy had 
struggled. It was practically a one-woman 
carry by Rulership that got them through.

text_block_list.name: Burly Man
text_block_list.text:
Kukuku, is that our opponent in the 
finals? Looks like light work to me!

text_block_list.name: Audacious Woman
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do you think so? They seem just right 
to play around with.

text_block_list.name: Tough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Alright guys, let's get on stage. It's 
time to show them the power of our 
Nightmare Order!
choice_data_list:
(Those are our opponents in the finals... 
they look tough)

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Now, it's finally time for the finals! 
Which team will reign at the absolute 
summit?!

text_block_list.name: Tough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Let me say one thing before we start. This 
isn't a battle... it's a massacre.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*, spare me the theatrics. We're just 
beginners, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
...Which means we don't know how to hold 
back.

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: Battle, STAAAART!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Epi, Eff! Lay down your cards however you 
like! Let's pull the early momentum 
straight to our side!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's what I'm talking about! 
Emptying the whole hand!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
Heart 5, 4... next is Club 3. A straight 
line toward victory.

text_block_list.name: Burly Man
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, dammit... I pass! This is insane, why 
can't I play anything...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Pisa, Logo, play at your own pace! That 
should disrupt their flow completely!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Next, next, next. Let's keep linking 
them together.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Pass, pass again... Ah, I can play this 
one.

text_block_list.name: Audacious Woman
text_block_list.text:
This disjointed, erratic tempo...! They're 
completely different from how they played 
up until the semifinals!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting, Taiho, 
Phalaeno! It's time to blow things wide 
open! Let's go all out!

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
Diamond... 3! Come on, swing for the 
fences!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Diamond... 2!! Now, try and stop us!

text_block_list.name: Tough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Eek?! This isn't the Seven Bridge I know! 
Wh-Wh-What is going on?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's exactly what it looks like. We're 
simply executing our strategy.

text_block_list.name: Tough-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
You call that a strategy?! Don't mess with 
me, there's neither rhyme nor reason to 
this!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, what a misguided critique. Strategy 
isn't merely about spinning theoretical 
logic.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Maximizing the potential of the hand 
you're dealt to secure victory, and 
constantly selecting the optimal move—that 
is true strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You misjudged our true capabilities. Now 
then, since you've thoroughly enjoyed the 
show—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I only have one card left. With Heart 1... 
it's game, set, and match!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOO—!!)

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Match over!! The champions are Team Tracen 
Academyyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Japan's number one Seven Bridge team is 
born right here and now!! How does it feel 
right now?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, victory is always sweet. Especially 
when a thoroughly calculated strategy 
falls right into place.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And this time, the team lineup was 
fantastic. Figuring out how to conquer the 
board with them was truly worth the 
challenge.
